recommendation: Keep the no-change audit for FHIR-36714. Revisit the Specimen bodyStructure naming/cardinality only when FHIR-54843 or a successor reaches Applied/Published and the broader R6 BodyStructure work is ready to reconcile.
issue_request: FHIR-36714 was a Published OO R5 change request asking to add Specimen.collection.bodySiteModifier as a repeating CodeableConcept matching v2 SPM-9 and to add guidance about laterality/pre-coordination. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution chose guidance for when to use a BodyStructure reference rather than adding a new element.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 2d61d16adb06711d12de13a8221b7fbd3fa90566, which replaced the old Specimen.collection.bodySite comment that referenced the bodySite extension with the approved BodyStructure guidance. The current source still carries that comment, and prior same-family work made Specimen.collection.bodySite a CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both BodyStructure and Specimen as active resources. OO Confluence minutes from 2022-04-11 record the motion, 6-0-1 vote, and exact replacement text; 2022-04-18 minutes mention applying FHIR-36714 as follow-up. FHIR-54843 is a later R6 Resolved - change required proposal to rename Specimen.collection.bodySite to bodyStructure, make it repeat, and adjust the same comment, but it is not Applied/Published and remains broader pending work for this default run.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The build-scoped Specimen StructureDefinition already includes the approved reasons for using a BodyStructure reference, and the element type supports either a coded body site or a BodyStructure reference.

related_jiras.note: Original Published request to tie Specimen.collection.bodySite to BodyStructure by making it a CodeableReference. It explains why the FHIR-36714 guidance can point to BodyStructure.
Published R5 decision confirming Specimen.collection.bodySite should be CodeableReference(BodyStructure). It is background for the seed, not a separate decision in this run.
Later R6 Resolved - change required proposal to rename bodySite to bodyStructure, make it repeat, and adjust the same comment. It is not Applied/Published for this default run.
